name: What are the most effective energy-efficient home improvements for older homes?

mainEntity.name: What are the most effective energy-efficient home improvements for older homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: For older homes, effective energy-efficient improvements often focus on sealing the building envelope. This includes upgrading insulation in attics, walls, and crawl spaces, replacing single-pane windows with double or triple-pane options, and sealing air leaks around doors, windows, and utility penetrations. A critical first step is often an energy audit to identify specific areas of heat loss or gain, as the optimal approach can vary significantly based on the home's construction and existing condition. This helps prioritize improvements that offer the best return on investment for your specific property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most effective improvements for older homes include insulation upgrades, window replacement, and air sealing. An energy audit can identify the best priorities for your specific home.
